name: agent_brief
description:
Runs `custodian agent brief`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. The first tool to call in a project.

The first line an agent runs in a project: the mode, the open jobs and what they wait on, the decisions to make first, the latest reading of each spec and whether the code moved since, the test lines' last results, and the exact next lines to run.

head.description: Only the head: the mode, the open job, the decisions and the next line (what the pre-edit hook prints). (`--head`)

name: run
description:
Runs `custodian run`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. A search on the line is `target` with `kind` (`reach`, `readers_of_env`, `impact`, ...).

One spec (a file, or a queued or done spec's name), a search on the line (`--kind` and a target), or every queued spec and job folder in order.

again.description: Read again even when the same spec ran over the same code. (`--again`)

job.description: The job the run is part of (the running job by default). (`--job`)

kind.description: The reading kind of a search on the line. (`--kind`)

target.description: A spec file, a queued or done spec's name, or (with `kind`) a route such as `crate:core_lib`; none runs the queue. (a word on the line)

name: list
description:
Runs `custodian list`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

The inventory, rendered from the journal (rebuilt from the receipts a checkout carries).

name: diff
description:
Runs `custodian diff`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

What moved between two readings of one spec (the last two by default).

spec.description: The spec's name (or its file). (a word on the line)

name: job_start
description:
Runs `custodian job start`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. A file no operation writes is allowed by a person (`job allow`), not here.

Opens a job: a queued folder (by name or id), else a new one for an agentic task; its mode, target and verification recorded at open.

baseline.description: Run the tests the target reaches at open, and keep them as the job's baseline: a test failing the same way there is not the job's failure at close. (`--baseline`)

budget.description: The job's budget, `hours=<n>,battery=<percent>`: a step whose measured time would take the job past its hours is refused before it starts; under the battery floor no cargo line starts. (`--budget`)

intent.description: What the job is for, in the asker's words: its task history's intent record. (`--intent`)

kind.description: What the job is: a folder of specs, or one of the templates. (`--kind`)

mode.description: `bounded` (the agent writes no code: change specs only) or `unbounded` (help, nothing refused). (`--mode`)

name.description: The job's name (a queued folder, or a new one). (a word on the line)

target.description: What the job works on: a route or an item (its target is known when it resolves). (`--target`)

verify.description: What done looks like: `test:<name>`, `reading:<spec>` (a reading that must change), `check:<which>`. (`--verify`)

name: job_close
description:
Runs `custodian job close`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

Closes the running job: its closing receipt, its task history's result (`accepted` only on evidence), its folder moved to done; a bounded job with lines no transform covers is refused, `rejected`.

name.description: The job's id (the running one by default). (a word on the line)

name: job_brief
description:
Runs `custodian job brief`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `bundle` packs the closed job as one bundle file too.

The facts of a job: open decisions first, the result, the mode and when its target and outcome became known, the readings, the lines touched; `--bundle` packs a closed job as one file too.

bundle.description: The closed job packed as one bundle too (its receipts, readings and the windows around its sites, secret items held redacted), as `custodian bundle <job>` makes it. (`--bundle`)

name.description: The job's id or name (the last closed one by default). (a word on the line)

name: job_list
description:
Runs `custodian job list`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

Every job folder by state, each with its task state (proposed, ready, running, blocked, paused, verifying, completed, failed).

name: job_verify
description:
Runs `custodian job verify`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

Declares what done looks like for the running job; the closing receipt records when the outcome became known.

job.description: The job (the running one by default). (`--job`)

line.description: `test:<name>`, `reading:<spec>` (a reading that must change), `check:<which>`. (a word on the line)

name: test
description:
Runs `custodian test run`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

The tests the change since `--ref` reaches (or every test line), each cargo line with its receipt and times.

affected.description: Only the tests the change since `git_ref` reaches. (`--affected`)

all_features.description: Each line with every feature on. (`--all-features`)

features.description: Each line with these features on (comma-separated), as cargo's `--features`. (`--features`)

git_ref.description: The git ref the change is measured from. (`--ref`)

job.description: The job the run is part of. (`--job`)

matrix.description: Each line once per configuration of its crate's check matrix (the transform's N of N: each feature set, with and without the defaults). (`--matrix`)

observe.description: What the run shows while it runs. (`--observe`)

name: test_report
description:
Runs `custodian test report`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

The last runs' outcomes: the slowest lines, the flakiest tests, maintenance's timed report; nothing run.

name: check
description:
Runs `custodian check`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

A maintenance check, through maintenance's own line, its JSON kept.

job.description: The job the run is part of. (`--job`)

which.description: The maintenance check to run. (a word on the line)

name: annotate
description:
Runs `custodian annotate`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. The plan only: placing it (`--apply`) is a person's.

The maintenance attributes the receipts call for, as a plan.

from.description: A check's JSON to plan from (the last check's by default). (`--from`)

name: features
description:
Runs `custodian features`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. The plan only: gating (`--apply`) is a person's.

code_passenger's feature-gating spec from the eligibility reading.

name: diagnostics_list
description:
Runs `custodian diagnostics list`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

Every liaise code table: each code's meaning and declaration, and the sites raising it.

krate.description: A crate (every crate by default). (a word on the line)

name: diagnostics_where
description:
Runs `custodian diagnostics where`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

Every site raising a diagnostic code, with its function.

code.description: The diagnostic code. (a word on the line)

name: diagnostics_from
description:
Runs `custodian diagnostics from`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

Each code a log names: its declaration and its sites.

log.description: The log file, `-` for stdin. (a word on the line)

name: triage
description:
Runs `custodian triage`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

The built-in triage job, started and closed.

target.description: A diagnostic code, or `@` and a log file. (a word on the line)

name: bundle
description:
Runs `custodian bundle`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

A route, a declared set or a job as one annotated file, its filters a checked word.

again.description: Bundle again even when the same bundle exists over the same code. (`--again`)

no_feature.description: Leave out the code behind this feature. (`--no-feature`)

redact_level.description: Redact items at this sensitivity level. (`--redact-level`)

target.description: A route, or a job's id. (a word on the line)

name: count
description:
Runs `custodian count of`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

Files, lines, code, comments and blanks of a route (custodian_kit's `count` reading kind, on tokei), per crate or language, and the tests' share.

again.description: Count again even when the code has not moved. (`--again`)

job.description: The job the count is part of (a job's own counts at open and close). (`--job`)

route.description: The route (the workspace by default). (a word on the line)

name: count_report
description:
Runs `custodian count report`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. `a` then `b`: a receipt number, a job id, a commit or a date.

Two counts compared: per crate and language, files added and removed, both digests.

a.description: The earlier count: a receipt number, a job id (`job:open`, `job:close`), a commit or a date. (a word on the line)

b.description: The later count. (a word on the line)

name: count_history
description:
Runs `custodian count history`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

Every count of a route (of every route by default).

route.description: The route. (a word on the line)

name: preflight
description:
Runs `custodian preflight`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. A change spec is decided here before it is made.

What a change spec entails over the code as it is, and whether it is authorized: where it lands, its impact and cost, its preconditions, the files it writes against the scope it may write, the decisions it leaves open; before anything is written.

batch.description: The spec is a batch: every member preflighted over one reading of the code (one scan, one code digest), each member's preconditions checked as its own preflight checks them, one receipt listing each member and its verdict (the batch transform's gate). (`--batch`)

job.description: The job it is part of (the running one by default). (`--job`)

spec.description: The change spec (`v1.<name>.1o.change`, or its TOML twin); with `--batch`, a file naming one change spec a line. (a word on the line)

name: transform
description:
Runs `custodian transform`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. The only way a bounded job's code is written.

A change spec made in the code by code_passenger, on the preflight receipt of this spec over this code: proved on the workspace's proof place, written with `--write`, its record kept; or a record's files put back (`--revert`). `--batch LIST`: James's rule for a repeated shape: one member proved alone first (its receipt is `--after-proof N`), then the rest as one batch (LIST: one spec a line, each on its own preflight) under one compile, one record and one receipt per member, a member that cannot go with the rest left out and named.

after_proof.description: The receipt of the one member of the batch's shape made alone and proved first. (`--after-proof`)

batch.description: A batch: a file naming one change spec a line. (`--batch`)

job.description: The job it is part of (the running one by default). (`--job`)

preflight.description: With `--batch`: each member preflighted here first, in this one run over one open workspace (one index parse for the batch), each with its own preflight receipt. (`--preflight`)

revert.description: A transform record whose files are put back. (`--revert`)

spec.description: The change spec. (a word on the line)

tests.description: The crate's tests run on the proof, compared with the same tests before the change. (`--tests`)

write.description: Write it (else prove it on a scratch copy only). (`--write`)

name: plan_make
description:
Runs `custodian plan make`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

An intent's plan: where the work is, what can be reused, what is new, the top candidates' impact and the cost, the decisions to make before any step, and the steps proposed; nothing written.

intent.description: The intent, in the asker's words. (a word on the line)

job.description: The job it is part of (the running one by default). (`--job`)

name.description: The plan's name (from the intent's words by default). (`--name`)

name: plan_approve
description:
Runs `custodian plan approve`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

A plan's step written as a change spec (`data/specs/changes/`), proposed until its preflight authorizes it.

job.description: The job it is part of (the running one by default). (`--job`)

operation.description: The operation (the step's first by default). (`--operation`)

plan.description: The plan's name. (a word on the line)

step.description: The step's number. (a word on the line)

name: plan_show
description:
Runs `custodian plan show`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

A plan's page.

job.description: The job it is part of (the running one by default). (`--job`)

plan.description: The plan's name. (a word on the line)

name: decide
description:
Runs `custodian decide`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. With no id, the open decisions; an answer is the person's, written as they gave it.

The decisions still open, asked together; with an id and an answer, one decision made (its reason with it), kept in the task history so it is never asked again.

answer.description: The answer. (a word on the line)

id.description: The decision's id (`q-…`). (a word on the line)

why.description: Why: the reasoning kept with the decision. (`--why`)

name: linkage_add
description:
Runs `custodian linkage add`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

A linkage record: why declarations are bound together, each bound declaration resolved now.

bind.description: A declaration bound: an item path, a crate:/decl: route, dep:<crate>. (`--bind`)

kind.description: Why they are bound: responsibility, invariant, connected, compatibility, synchronized, guarded, semantics. (`--kind`)

name.description: The record's name. (a word on the line)

why.description: The reason, in the author's words. (`--why`)

name: linkage_check
description:
Runs `custodian linkage check`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

The linkage records naming a target (every record by default), each checked against the code: stale, to review, or holding; and the comment anchors no record backs.

target.description: An item, a route or a record's name. (a word on the line)

name: exercise_report
description:
Runs `custodian exercise report`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. What an exercise found: what to fix first, every finding with its receipt.

An exercise job's summary, the newest when none is named. Cases run and passed, the findings by code, what to fix first, the operation × unit matrix, the slowest cases, every finding with its receipt.

job.description: The exercise job: its id or name. (a word on the line)

name: handoff
description:
Runs `custodian handoff`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. After a job: the message its records make, what waits on a person first; `reader` `agent` adds the lines to run.

The message a person reads after a job, from the records only: what waits on a person first, then what the job was for, what changed, what was decided and by whom, what was verified, and what runs next; short, every list cut with "… and N more".

job.description: The job's id or name (the job closed last by default; with `--since`, every job that ran after it). (a word on the line)

reader.description: Who reads it: `james` (sentences) or `agent` (the exact lines to run and the routes too). (`--for`)

since.description: Only what happened after this receipt. (`--since`)

name: why
description:
Runs `custodian why`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt. Before changing a crate: why it is there, from the records.

Who introduced a crate: or decl: route and for what: the task histories whose changes touch it, the linkage records binding it, the readings about it, and git's first and last commit touching its files (a git log line with its receipt); "no record" where the records say nothing.

route.description: A `crate:` or `decl:` route. (a word on the line)

name: cost
description:
Runs `custodian cost`, a declared line; every run leaves a receipt.

The tokens readings stood for: read against reused, the tokens an agent would have spent reading the same files by hand against the tokens reuse saved, per reading kind and per job (an estimate: bytes/4 of the files each reading touched).

since.description: Only the runs after this receipt. (`--since`)
